title: Disc jockeys and playing his records
summary: Machito says he prefers DJs who play his records because they like them, not because they are forced to.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Is jazz healthy? Young players, rock and the future

blocks.x: Okay, I know it runs into about fifty or around that area. Now, with all these recordings that are out there, why haven't disk jockeys played some of your recordings? You know, we have a lot of Latin music now, not enough Latin music on the air now, but more than we've had any other time before. We have Roger Dawson, we have - myself and Polito Vega are the only ones that are playing Machito recordings. Why haven't the other ones played them, Macho? Does it bother you?
No. Let me tell you, if they had the ....
I want to add that WKCR, Carlos de Leon, Jose Luis Morin and Cheo Diaz, play a lot of Machito records.

All right, those people, they know what they are playing, they like what they are playing. I don't like to somebody play my records because is in the program, because somebody forced them to play or for the administration say play Machito records. I like to listen to the music that the disk jockey wants to play. That made me enjoy more than if I know that's above the fifteen minutes, the twenty minutes or whatever, to listen to the music that I play or because the promoter, that's going to run the dance, in that particular segment of his advertisement include my number. I know that my number is included because I want to play that particular number.
